Capture: an enemy can be captured once its HP is at or below this percent of its maximum. Bosses cannot be captured.
Ransom: extra gold per enemy captured rather than defeated (a defeat is worth income_per_kill, so mercy pays better but drops no weapon).
Shove (map action): tiles an adjacent unit is pushed straight away from the shover. Gunnar starts with this; it upgrades to Smite once he is certified.
Smite (map action): the same push, one tile further. A class with 'smite' in classes.map_actions (the Housecarl) has it from the start; a shove unit gains it on certification.
Tiles an armor-movement target resists a Shove/Smite (so a plain Shove cannot move armor at all, a Smite moves it one). Bosses are never pushed.

Shove/Smite collision: a pushed unit that hits a wall, the map edge or another unit takes this percent of its own max HP (rounded down); a unit it hits takes the same of its own. Never lethal: it stops at 1 HP.
Bribe (Kheldar's map action): gold base price to turn an adjacent enemy neutral for the rest of the map.
Bribe: extra gold per level of the enemy (a level-5 levy costs 90, a level-10 billman 140).
Bribe: how many enemies Kheldar can turn per map (canon: 'bribe one enemy to neutral'). Bosses cannot be bribed.
ep_delivery: a unit 'escorts' a cargo unit if it is alive and within this many tiles of the goal when the cargo is delivered.
Talk (map action): base chance in percent that an adjacent talkable enemy yields.
Talk: + this many percent per point of the speaker's Lck.
Talk: + this many percent per level the speaker is above the enemy (minus per level below).
Talk: the chance never drops below this percent.
Talk: the chance never rises above this percent.
Extra gold per enemy that fled the field (routed) rather than being defeated, captured or talked down.
Extra gold per enemy talked down.
Forge: master works a playthrough may commission (canon: a hard cap of 3 against 5 possible drops).
Forge: HP the Feather Blade restores to each ally beside its wielder on a hit (canon's Simurgh: 5 HP, flat).
Forge: a weapon made from a harvested (captured, diminished) material has this percent of the usual uses.
A guest unit (Anna) joins this many levels under the squad's median, from her class's trained baseline grown by her profile's expected rates.
Deputy scoring: an action is 'witnessed' if the unit that did it is within this many tiles of the surveyor (the camp, the middle of the deploy row).
Deputy scoring: the Column B supply attachment, drafted as this much gold on each Column B chapter newly won -- withheld if the player contested the crown's choice of deputy at the writ scene.
Weapon names: the most marks (deeds earned with it) a weapon keeps; the oldest is dropped for a new one.
Weapon names: gold a master smith charges to reforge a marked weapon from the convoy, clearing its marks.
Sapper: charges a Sapper has on one map, shared between Breach and Mine.
Sapper: flat damage a mine does to the first enemy that ends a move on it (a bit under a steel sword hit).
Weapons: HP the Miroslav Gospel's wielder recovers after every blow that lands.
Weapons: percent of the damage dealt that the Goetia of Astaroth returns to its reader as health (rounded down).
Weapons: HP The Lemegeton costs its reader each time they fight with it (never lethal: it stops at 1).
Skald: percent chance a Steal succeeds against an enemy of equal speed.
Skald: percentage points of Steal chance for each point of the Skald's speed over the enemy's (and minus for each under). Never below 5% or above 95%.
Skald: tiles around her (Manhattan) in which the Epithet Aura reaches, herself included.
Skald: hit and avoid each ally in the aura gains for every deed (epithet) it has earned.
Skald: the most hit and avoid the aura can give one ally (three deeds' worth).
Martyr: how many times on one map a blow that would kill a Martyr leaves them at 1 HP instead.
Requisition tier 2 (two open orders) once this map is won: the Second Writ.
Requisition tier 3 (three open orders, and silver weapons) once this map is won: the Reunion.
Standard forge: gold for a basic (iron) weapon.
Standard forge: gold for a mid (steel) weapon.
Standard forge: gold for a high (silver) weapon, which needs requisition tier 3.
Standard forge: percent off the weapons of that forge's house arts (forges.house_arts).
Mounts: a Named creature captured at or below this percent of its max HP is taken INTACT (a mount); between this and capture_hp_pct it is harvested for a diminished material.
Mounts: HP the Simurgh restores at the start of each of your turns to its rider and every ally beside them (canon: 5 flat).
Mounts: tiles the Karkadann's rider must have moved this turn for the charge to count.
Mounts: damage added to the Karkadann rider's attack after a charge; the rider is then stuck (cannot move) on their next turn.
Mounts: the most Warhorses one map's captures of mounted enemies can bring in.
The Huma: the maps its shadow drifts over (pipe-delimited ids in the text column). Canon: a map hazard, not a mount -- it never lands, so it belongs to the open road.
The Huma: the shadow covers every tile within this many tiles of its centre, in both directions (2 = a 5 x 5 patch).
The Huma: columns the shadow's centre drifts east each turn; it wraps to the west edge at the far end. Its row is the middle of the map.
The Huma: the column the shadow's centre lies over on turn 1.
The Huma: every unit standing in the shadow (yours or theirs) gains this much str, mag, def, res and spd -- 'marked units gain stats'.
